Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in the left lane of northbound traffic on a Conroe, Teaxs roadway when Driver 2 failed to slow in
time and struck the rear of the vehicle. Driver 1 was operating the vehicle at the time of impact, and a Passenger was
also seated inside. Responding officers confirmed that Driver 1 and the Passenger were both present in the vehicle
when the collision occurred, and that fact was consistent with statements taken at the scene. Driver 2 stated that the
collision happened in the manner Driver 1 described, and two independent witnesses gave accounts that matched
this description. Scene photographs were taken and reviewed. The damage to the rear of Driver 1's vehicle
corresponds to the force and point of impact observed at the scene. No prior damage to the vehicle was reported or
observed. Driver 1 reported neck and back discomfort following the impact, a complaint that fits the nature and force
of a rear-end collision of this kind. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved.
